title: Data and code for: Triplication in the plant sciences: a protocol report from the 2017 literature and the general methodological case for three replicates
description:
Supplementary data, documents and R code accompanying the manuscript Triplication in the plant sciences: a protocol report from the 2017 literature and the general methodological case for three replicates (Clark, Szczypiór-Piasecka, Rydzewska and Podsiadło). The archive contains the supplemental files S1–S13, including definitions (S1), the 2017 plant-science journal grid (S4), the Protocol Report of screened 2017 plant-science articles (S5), the R coding files (S7, S11), the derivation of equation 7 (S10), excluded journal articles (S12) and the heuristic guide for the Protocol Report (S13).

Licensing: data and documents are licensed under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE). R code is licensed separately (see LICENSE-CODE).
